question: As of today, what did the US Federal Reserve most recently decide on its policy interest rate?
report_markdown:
# Latest FOMC decision

At its most recent meeting the committee left the target range unchanged [1]. The statement signalled patience on further changes [7]. Market pricing implies a cut at the next meeting.

findings.claim: The committee left the target range unchanged at its most recent meeting.
The statement signalled patience on further changes.

sources.title: Rate cut odds climb
sources.used_for: Market expectations for the next meeting.
